title: A pump swapped for a new design, year by year

blocks.text: A water utility plans to swap an old pump for a unit of a newer design. The old pump has age `age` in the plan's first year and a Weibull curve (`beta`, `eta`); the new design has its own curve (`beta_new`, `eta_new`). The work starts in `start` and lasts `duration` years; the old pump runs until the work ends, and the new unit is in service, at age 0, from the year after. Failed pumps are repaired and kept, so a year's risk is `cof` times the expected failures in that year.
Write `yearly_cut(pump, years, start, duration)` in `refurb.py`: a dict from each year in `years` (the first is the plan's first year) to the risk removed that year, $k.

In the lesson's notation, write $`\delta_y`$ as the risk of the old pump at its age $`a^0_y`$ minus the risk with the work, which now comes from a different curve. `failures(age, beta, eta)` is written for you. The tests compute expected failures from `scipy.stats.weibull_min.logsf`. About ten lines.

"""Run executes this file. Change the calls and see what prints. Submit grades."""
import logging

# Turn the logger up, so the `log.debug` lines of your code show under the printed lines.
logging.basicConfig(level=logging.DEBUG, format="%(levelname)s %(message)s")

from refurb import Pump, yearly_cut

pump = Pump(30, 2.5, 35.0, 1.8, 55.0, 700.0)
years = list(range(2030, 2036))

print("start 2031, 1 year of work:", {y: round(v, 2) for y, v in yearly_cut(pump, years, 2031, 1).items()})
print("start 2031, 2 years of work:", {y: round(v, 2) for y, v in yearly_cut(pump, years, 2031, 2).items()})

cases.says: no risk is removed before the work ends, and some is removed in every year after it
after the work, the risk is that of the new design's curve
the new unit is one year older in each year after it is installed
the risk without the work is that of the old pump at its age in that year

origin.section: The Risk Removed in a Year Is the Risk Without the Work Minus the Risk With It

concepts: work resets the asset's age after it ends, and the asset ages from there
the yearly reduction is the risk without the work minus the risk with it
